prompt: Mia types $240$ words in $4$ minutes. How many words **per minute**?
hint: Words per minute is a unit rate. Ask yourself how many words fit into each one of the minutes if Mia types steadily.

hints.text: Words per minute is a unit rate. Ask yourself how many words fit into each one of the minutes if Mia types steadily.
Mia's $240$ words are spread evenly over $4$ minutes, so divide: work out $240 \div 4$.
$240 \div 4 = 60$, so Mia types $60$ words per minute.

explanation: A "per minute" rate tells the amount for $1$ minute, so divide the words by the minutes.
Write the rate as $\frac{240 \text{ words}}{4 \text{ minutes}}$ and divide both parts by $4$.
Since $24 \div 4 = 6$, it follows that the larger division $240 \div 4$ equals $60$.
Mia types at a rate of $60$ words per minute.
